rationale: The assistant immediately identified restricted airflow as the likely cause, told the customer to unplug first, and ordered the checks correctly (door filter, condenser, load/spin/programme, then heat check) with a clear engineer boundary if cold. It used the customer's evidence accurately, drew the right conclusion ('all of that points to the wax-coated filter and lint-matted condenser restricting airflow') and gave sensible prevention advice without recommending parts or an engineer. The only minor blemish is the odd stray 'Before you start, switch it off and unplug it' at the top of the closing message when no further work was being proposed.
